region_scene_page.compact: Classic country crystallized through radio, touring, the Opry, and Nashville songcraft, carrying rural and working-class stories into national popular culture.
region_scene_page.standard: Classic country crystallized through radio, touring, the Opry, and Nashville songcraft, carrying rural and working-class stories into national popular culture.
